title: Before the First Step | JFK Motivation
narration: Before the first footprint, there was a promise. Seven years later, people walked on the Moon. Years of engineering, training and tests stood between those moments. Your next step can be smaller. Choose the project you keep postponing. Set a timer. Start the part you can finish today. Tomorrow, build from there.

description:
An original historical motivational short: JFK's 1962 Moon challenge, Apollo 11 in 1969, and a reflection on starting the project you keep postponing. Archival pictures are reframed excerpts, not new recordings.
